title: GTA 6 Has a Fridge Menu 🍺
youtube_description:
GTA 6 has a fridge menu. In Rockstar's An Extended Look (at 7:15), a man walks through a pink apartment's kitchen to a fridge covered in magnets, photos and sticky notes, and the button prompt just says FRIDGE. Open it, and a list comes up over the shelves: Logger Beer, Lavazas Beer, Blitz Berry Smoothie, Blitz Green Smoothie and Protein Shake. The beers get no icons; the smoothies and the shake each get two small round icons, and Rockstar hasn't said what they do. A Fleeca Bank magnet is even on the fridge door, and once he's holding a bottle, the prompts read Drink (R1) and Drop. Rockstar says the Extended Look was captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5.

Beer or smoothie: what are you grabbing first?

Sources (Rockstar Games, read Nov 24, 2026):
- Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look, August 27, 2026, 7:15 to 7:23 ("Captured entirely from in-game footage on the PlayStation 5"): https://www.rockstargames.com/VI/an-extended-look
- Grand Theft Auto VI, out November 19, 2026: https://www.rockstargames.com/VI

The drawn fridge, the re-typed drink list (tagged RE-DRAWN) and the vote card in this Short are our own graphics; the zoomed list beside it is Rockstar's own frame at 7:19, shown 3x. The list fades at its bottom edge, so there may be more drinks below Protein Shake. We don't know what the icons mean, whose apartment it is or which drink he took.

Clips: Rockstar Games (Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look), used for commentary. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
